content.short: Cellana is a community-owned DEX on Aptos, the first to implement the ve(3,3) governance model using the Move language.
content.description:
Cellana is a pioneering decentralized exchange native to the Aptos ecosystem, distinguished as the first to implement the ve(3,3) economic model using the Move programming language. This model aligns the interests of liquidity providers and token holders by allowing users to lock CELL tokens in exchange for veCELL NFTs. These NFTs grant voting power to direct emissions to specific pools, with voters receiving 100% of the trading fees from those pools.

The platform utilizes hybrid swap algorithms, including vAMM for uncorrelated assets and sAMM for stablecoins, to ensure minimal slippage and optimal pricing. Additionally, Cellana serves as a launchpad for new projects on Aptos, helping them bootstrap liquidity and gain community support. By combining a robust trading engine with sophisticated governance, Cellana aims to be a core liquidity hub for the Aptos network.
